shared_prompt: Create one premium fantasy world-map march creature as a production transparent PNG cutout. Hand-painted storybook mobile-strategy style matching Conquer: large soft exaggerated forms, immediately readable silhouette, warm dark-brown outlines, restrained colors, two broad toon-shading values, no photorealism or glossy PBR. Slightly elevated three-quarter view, moving toward the right. Center the whole creature with generous clear margin. No human troop formation, text, UI, environment, ground plane, rectangular background, drop shadow, logo or watermark. True transparent alpha.
